placements.role: Operates N2 foundry capacity in high-volume manufacturing for HPC and AI applications.

role_evidence.claim: TSMC's exact first-quarter 2026 transcript says N2 entered high-volume manufacturing in the fourth quarter of 2025 and was ramping at Hsinchu and Kaohsiung, supported by strong HPC and AI demand.

placements.role: Provides 3DFabric and CoWoS-class advanced stacking and packaging alongside leading-edge wafer fabrication.

role_evidence.claim: TSMC's 2025 annual-report chapter says it provides 3DFabric advanced silicon stacking and packaging solutions as part of its foundry services.

business_summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited is the world's leading-edge contract foundry, listed on TWSE as 2330 with an NYSE ADR line under TSM. It fabricates other companies' designs at the most advanced nodes and, through 3DFabric and CoWoS-class stacking, also performs the advanced packaging step. For this chain it is the single point through which almost all leading-edge AI silicon passes.

exposure_summary.narrative: Two placements, both VERIFIED from the issuer's own documents. foundry (position 6) is the chain's CHOKE_POINT link, described in the chain as effectively one supplier at the leading edge and a geopolitical single point of failure; its heat verdict is CROWDED at crowdedness 72 with capture 85, the highest capture score among the links this batch touches. advanced-packaging (position 7, heat EMERGING) is backed by TSMC's own 2025 annual-report chapter on 3DFabric. The exposure is not in doubt; the measurement of it is.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: TSMC discloses revenue by technology node and by platform (HPC, smartphone, IoT, automotive), not by AI end market, and no percentage attributable to this chain was read from a primary source this run.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 1,936,095,600,000 TWD divided by revenue 3,809,054,300,000 TWD, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 2,274,975,600,000 TWD divided by net income 1,697,604,000,000 TWD, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 2,274,975,600,000 TWD less capex 1,282,597,200,000 TWD, divided by revenue 3,809,054,300,000 TWD, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -1,703,273,700,000 TWD (total debt 1,064,582,700,000 less cash 2,767,856,400,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 2,624,192,000,000 TWD (operating income 1,936,095,600,000 plus depreciation 688,096,400,000 for the period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 9 (state STRONG) computed over yfinance-statements statements in 2330-TW.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.7 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over yfinance-statements statements in 2330-TW.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 62,756,709,340,820 TWD computed in 2330-TW.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 62,756,709,340,820 TWD divided by revenue 3,809,054,300,000 TWD for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 61,053,435,640,820 TWD implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 992,378,400,000 TWD, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.3777, '7': 0.2767, '10': 0.206}). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.

crowdedness_caveats: The foundry link's heat verdict is CROWDED, crowdedness 72, capture 85 (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json). TSMC is the most-covered name on the most critical link; nothing about this profile suggests it is undiscovered.
data/market/TSM.json carries no pcs block, so analyst count and institutional ownership were not measured; the crowdedness reading here rests on the link, not on the stock.
The 52-week range on the ADR is 228.39 to 477.57 against a 417.52 close, near the top of its own range.
No valuation multiple is computed anywhere on this profile, so this file contains no basis at all for a priced-in judgement. That is the point of the BLOCKED status.

catalysts.claim: TSMC's own first-quarter 2026 earnings-call transcript says N2 entered high-volume manufacturing in the fourth quarter of 2025 and was ramping at Hsinchu and Kaohsiung, supported by strong HPC and AI demand. That is the dated basis of the foundry placement.

TSMC's own fourth-quarter 2025 results release reports quarterly consolidated revenue of NT$1,046.09 billion and US$33.73 billion, net income of NT$505.74 billion, gross margin 62.3%, operating margin 54.0% and net profit margin 48.3%, with diluted EPS of NT$19.50. These figures are recorded here as dated evidence and deliberately NOT used as canonical metric values, because they are one quarter rather than a fiscal year and no fiscal-year statement was readable from a primary source this run.

Newly filled fundamentals (2026-08-30, yfinance-statements) show 18.93% three-year revenue CAGR, a CLEAN Beneish read (-2.7), a STRONG Piotroski score (9/9), a 50.83% operating margin, the strongest evidence this profile carries for the 2330.TW placement.

risks.claim: The chain itself records the structural risk: the foundry link is effectively one supplier at the leading edge and a geopolitical single point of failure. Concentration is the reason this link matters and the reason it is dangerous.

No fundamentals, no earnings-quality state, no leverage reading and no valuation multiple exist for this issuer in the local stores, so the expectations gap cannot be posed at all. The most important name on this chain is currently the least measurable.
